newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products weaker, except fuel oil cargoes.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products weaker, except fuel oil cargoes.

text.p: NWE oil products were mainly weaker on Monday
Gasoline fell sharply and prices appeared to be almost low enough to foster transatlantic business.
Naphtha fell too. The market is relatively tight, with bids for pipeline quality seen at $207 cif NWE.
Gas oil waned with futures, but barge traders said the dip in outright prices had not boosted demand.
High sulphur barges also tumbled with futures losing $7 to $110 fob ARA, but cargoes resisted the pull down and were broadly steady as tight fundamentals started to show through.
